page: Amazon Web Services c8ine.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The hardware profile utilizes an x86_64 Intel processor clocked at 3.9 GHz, featuring 8 physical cores and 16 dedicated virtual CPUs through simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is set to 32.0 GB, resulting in a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance configuration includes no integrated local storage devices, requiring storage needs to be handled externally via network-attached solutions such as Amazon Elastic Block Store. The network subsystem delivers a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs present in the design, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are allocated to the virtual machine.

By omitting internal disks and graphics processing units, resource allocation is consolidated around high-frequency CPU compute and network throughput. This configuration targets compute-dense tasks where local ephemeral caching is not required, making it appropriate for distributed compilation pipelines, CI/CD builders, batch data processing, and scalable web serving tiers.
